_readme: Owner-written interview questions. Only status 'approved' entries appear on the site. Shape: {id, stack, topic, difficulty, status, question, answer, tip?}. stack is one of snowflake, sql, pipelines, modeling, spark, cloud; difficulty is Beginner, Intermediate or Advanced. Write these yourself: the bank must not present generated text as yours. 'exclude' hides any question id (including cheat-sheet ones) from the bank and drill.
